items.source: This package and related packages are discussed in Chapter 11 of Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development by Rod Johnson (Wrox, 2002).
items.translation: 本包及相关包在 Rod Johnson 所著的《Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development》（Wrox，2002）第 11 章中进行了讨论。 Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development

items.source:
Provides an alternative to the Singleton and Prototype design
patterns, including a consistent approach to configuration management.
Builds on the org.springframework.beans package.
items.translation: 提供了一种替代单例和原型设计模式的方法，包括一致的配置管理方法。基于 org.springframework.beans 包构建。

items.source: Callback interface for initializing a Spring ListableBeanFactory prior to entering the singleton pre-instantiation phase.
items.translation: 用于在单例预实例化阶段之前初始化 Spring ListableBeanFactory 的回调接口。

items.source: Convenience methods operating on bean factories, in particular on the ListableBeanFactory interface.
items.translation: 操作 Bean 工厂的便捷方法，特别是针对 `ListableBeanFactory` 接口。

items.source: Counterpart of BeanNameAware.
items.translation: `BeanNameAware` 的对应项。

items.source: Extension of the FactoryBean interface.
items.translation: `FactoryBean` 接口的扩展。FactoryBean。

items.source: Contract for registering beans programmatically, typically imported with an @Import annotation on a @Configuration class.
items.translation: 用于程序化注册 Bean 的契约，通常通过导入到 `@Import` 注解上的`@Configuration`类来使用。

items.source: Support package for the Java ServiceLoader facility.
items.translation: 支持用于 Java ServiceLoader 设施的支持包。

items.source: Callback that allows a bean to be aware of the bean class loader; that is, the class loader used by the present bean factory to load bean classes.
items.translation: 允许 Bean 感知其使用的类加载器（即当前 Bean 工厂用于加载 Bean 类的类加载器）的回调；参见 java.lang.ClassLoader。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by beans that wish to be aware of their owning BeanFactory.
items.translation: 希望感知其拥有者BeanFactory的 Bean 需要实现的接口。

items.source: Used in BeanRegistrar.register(BeanRegistry, Environment) to expose programmatic bean registration capabilities.
items.translation: 用于在BeanRegistrar.register(BeanRegistry, Environment)中暴露程序化 Bean 注册功能。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by objects used within a BeanFactory which are themselves factories for individual objects.
items.translation: 由在 `BeanFactory` 中使用的对象实现的接口，这些对象本身是单个对象的工厂。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by beans that need to react once all their properties have been set by a BeanFactory: for example, to perform custom initialization, or merely to check that all mandatory properties have been set.
items.translation: 需要由在 BeanFactory 的所有属性设置完成后需要做出反应的 Bean 实现的接口：例如，执行自定义初始化，或仅仅检查所有必需属性是否已设置。

items.source: Extension of the BeanFactory interface to be implemented by bean factories that can enumerate all their bean instances, rather than attempting bean lookup by name one by one as requested by clients.
items.translation: 扩展 `BeanFactory` 接口，供能够枚举所有 Bean 实例的 Bean Factory 实现，而不是像客户端请求的那样逐个尝试按名称查找 Bean。

items.source: A variant of ObjectFactory designed specifically for injection points, allowing for programmatic optionality and lenient not-unique handling.
items.translation: 专为注入点设计的 `ObjectFactory` 变体，支持编程式可选性和宽松的非唯一性处理。

items.source: Callback interface triggered at the end of the singleton pre-instantiation phase during BeanFactory bootstrap.
items.translation: 在 `BeanFactory` 引导期间，于单例预实例化阶段结束时触发的回调接口。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.beans.factory package.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.beans.factory包的类。

items.source: Contains an abstract XML-based BeanFactory implementation, including a standard "spring-beans" XSD.
items.translation: 包含一个抽象的基于 XML 的 `BeanFactory` 实现，包括标准的"spring-beans"XSD。

items.source: Exception to be thrown from a FactoryBean's getObject() method if the bean is not fully initialized yet, for example because it is involved in a circular reference.
items.translation: 如果 Bean 尚未完全初始化（例如因为它涉及循环引用），则从 FactoryBean 的getObject()方法抛出的异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when a BeanFactory is asked for a bean instance for which it cannot find a definition.
items.translation: 当请求一个无法找到定义的 Bean 实例时，BeanFactory 会抛出异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when a BeanFactory is asked for a bean instance for which multiple matching candidates have been found when only one matching bean was expected.
items.translation: 当请求一个 `BeanFactory` 的 Bean 实例时，如果预期只找到一个匹配的 Bean，但发现了多个匹配候选者，则抛出异常。

items.source: This package contains interfaces and classes for manipulating Java beans.
items.translation: 该包包含用于操作 Java 对象的接口和类。

items.source: Support package for annotation-driven bean configuration.
items.translation: 用于注解驱动的 Bean 配置的辅助包。

items.source: AOT support for bean factories.
items.translation: 支持 AOT 的 BeanFactory。

items.source: AspectJ-based dependency injection support.
items.translation: 基于 AspectJ 的依赖注入支持。

items.source: SPI interfaces and configuration-related convenience classes for bean factories.
items.translation: 用于 Bean 工厂的 SPI 接口和与配置相关的便捷类。

items.source: Support package for Groovy-based bean definitions.
items.translation: 基于 Groovy 的 Bean 定义支持包。

items.source: Support infrastructure for bean definition parsing.
items.translation: 支持 Bean 定义解析的基础设施。

items.source: Mechanism to determine bean wiring metadata from a bean instance.
items.translation: 用于从 Bean 实例确定 Bean 线绑元数据的机制。

items.source:
A marker superinterface indicating that a bean is eligible to be notified by the
Spring container of a particular framework object through a callback-style method.
items.translation: 一个标记超接口，指示该 Bean 可通过回调风格的方法由 Spring 容器通知特定的框架对象。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a BeanFactory encounters an error when
attempting to create a bean from a bean definition.
items.translation: 当 BeanFactory 尝试从 BeanDefinition 创建 Bean 时遇到错误而抛出的异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown in case of a bean being requested despite
bean creation currently not being allowed (for example, during
the shutdown phase of a bean factory).
items.translation: 在请求 Bean 但当前不允许创建 Bean 的情况下抛出异常（例如，在 BeanFactory 的关闭阶段）。

items.source: Exception thrown in case of a reference to a bean that's currently in creation.
items.translation: 在引用当前正在创建的 Bean 时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a BeanFactory encounters an invalid bean definition:
for example, in case of incomplete or contradictory bean metadata.
items.translation: 当 BeanFactory 遇到无效的 Bean 定义时抛出异常：例如，在 Bean 元数据不完整或相互矛盾的情况下。

items.source: Exception that indicates an expression evaluation attempt having failed.
items.translation: 表示表达式求值尝试失败的异常。

items.source: The root interface for accessing a Spring bean container.
items.translation: 访问 Spring Bean 容器的根接口。

items.source:
Exception that a bean implementation is suggested to throw if its own
factory-aware initialization code fails.
items.translation: 如果 Bean 自身的工厂感知初始化代码失败，建议抛出的异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a bean instance has been requested for
a bean definition which has been marked as abstract.
items.translation: 当请求一个被标记为抽象的 Bean 定义的 Bean 实例时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a bean is not a factory, but a user tries to get
at the factory for the given bean name.
items.translation: 当用户尝试获取给定 Bean 名称的工厂，但该 Bean 并非工厂时抛出的异常。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by beans that want to be aware of their
bean name in a bean factory.
items.translation: 希望了解其在 Bean 工厂中的 Bean 名称的 Bean 需要实现的接口。

items.source: Thrown when a bean doesn't match the expected type.
items.translation: 抛出当 Bean 不匹配预期类型时。

items.source: Specification for customizing a bean.
items.translation: 自定义 Bean 的规范。

items.source:
Context available from the bean instance supplier designed to give access
to bean dependencies.
items.translation: 由用于访问 Bean 依赖项的 Bean 实例供应商设计的上下文。

items.source:
Exception thrown when the BeanFactory cannot load the specified class
of a given bean.
items.translation: 当 BeanFactory 无法加载给定 bean 的指定类时抛出异常。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by beans that want to release resources on destruction.
items.translation: 希望销毁时释放资源的 Bean 需要实现的接口。

items.source:
Sub-interface implemented by bean factories that can be part
of a hierarchy.
items.translation: 由可以作为层次结构一部分的 Bean 工厂实现的子接口。

items.source:
A simple descriptor for an injection point, pointing to a method/constructor
parameter or a field.
items.translation: 用于指向方法/构造函数参数或字段的简单注入点描述符。

items.source:
Defines a factory which can return an Object instance
(possibly shared or independent) when invoked.
items.translation: 定义一个工厂，在调用时返回一个对象实例（可能是共享的或独立的）。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a bean depends on other beans or simple properties
that were not specified in the bean factory definition, although
dependency checking was enabled.
items.translation: 当 Bean 依赖于未在 Bean 工厂定义中指定的其他 Bean 或简单属性，且启用了依赖检查时抛出异常。
